item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 31/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A southwesterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the next few days. It will be persistently hot with a few showers over the region. A trough of low pressure is expected to linger over Guangdong early next week and bring thundery showers to the region.

Date/Month: 31/05 (Tuesday)
Wind: South force 2 to 3.
Weather: Hot with sunny periods and a few showers. Isolated thunderstorms at first.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Medium Low
